title: [ingest] Self-planning (action:'plan') is opt-in, default OFF
summary: The daemon only returns action:'plan' when state.overlay.config.self_plan is true AND the DAG is drained AND budget remains. self_plan defaults off — the daemon stays 'dumb' unless explicitly enabled per-workspace.
